title: Prerequisites
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM
In Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable, you create business partners with customer or vendor master records manually. On
the SAP Easy Access screen, choose |sAccounting Financial Accounting » Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable » Master
Data Business Partner  Customer/Customer Integration } Create Business Partner with Customer 9 and |»Supplier/ Vendor

Integration » Create Business Partner with Vendor .. There you can also access transactions for changing and displaying master
data. These transactions use role groupings that already contain the necessary roles for synchronous creation of

customers/customers and suppliers/vendors. This ensures that the system creates the business partner in the role MKK, and that
you can enter information on the company code and sales (or the company code and purchasing) using the roles FLCU00 and
FLCUOQ1 or FLVNOO and FLVNO1.

Prerequisites

e You are familiar with the basic settings of the master data objects business partner, customer, and vendor.

e You have experience with configuring the data exchange using CRM middleware — assuming that SAP CRM is part of your

scenario.

e During the synchronization and replication, both the S/AHANA system and the CRM system are available - assuming CRM
is part of your scenario.

1 Note

For more information, see the following SAP Notes:

SAP Note         Description
852870 Phe         BP_CVI: Changes in BDT Customizing for ERP 2005

905535 Phe       Useful Notes — CVI for Master Data Synchronization

928616 Php        BP_CVI: Customizing of Required Entry Fields for BP/Customer

941955 Phe        BP_CVI: Integration of Customers/Vendors with SAP BP

954816 Phe         BP_CVI: Transactions for Creating/Linking BPs

956054 Pie        BP_CVI Customer / Vendor Integration as of ERP2005 (ECC600)

1968132 Phe       Business Partner Replication Between CRM and ECC with Active CVI

Activities

If you are using the integration between SAP CRM and SAP S/HANA, then you have to make the settings described in all of the
following topics. If you are using only SAP S/4HANA, then only make the settings described in the following two topics:

e Making Settings for Customer/Vendor Integration

e Making Settings for the Postprocessing Office

The synchronization and replication of master data between SAP CRM and SAP S/4HANA requires extensive settings:

e For the SAP business partner in the S/4AHANA system and CRM system
